simp.text: 地上热得像一个烧红的大铁锅。

trad.text: 地上熱得像一個燒紅的大鐵鍋。
trad.bpmf: 地上熱得󠇡像一󠇡個󠇡燒紅的大鐵鍋。

example.en: The ground was as hot as a big iron pot glowing red.

simp.text: 自己却再也回不了家了。

trad.text: 自己卻再也回不了家了。
trad.bpmf: 自己卻再也回不了󠇡家了。

example.en: He himself could never go home again.

simp.text: 躲在门后偷看的村民，一个个都看呆了。

trad.text: 躲在門後偷看的村民，一個個都看呆了。
trad.bpmf: 躲在門後偷看的村民，一󠇡個󠇡個󠇡都看呆了。

example.en: The villagers peeking out from behind their doors were all stunned.
He lifted down the red bow.
He drew out a white arrow.

simp.text: 躲在家里也拼命的流汗。

trad.text: 躲在家裡也拼命的流汗。
trad.bpmf: 躲在家裡也拼命的流汗。

example.en: Even hiding indoors, they were pouring with sweat.
Go quietly back up to the Fusang tree.
There were ten suns in the sky.

simp.text: 抬头看著又高又远的天空。

trad.text: 抬頭看著又高又遠的天空。
trad.bpmf: 抬頭看著又高又遠的天空。

example.en: She lifted her head and looked at the sky, so high and so far away.
They lived far to the east, by the edge of the great sea.
The rivers dried up in a single day.
It turned into a blazing ball of fire.

simp.text: 田里的稻子一片一片枯黄。

trad.text: 田裡的稻子一片一片枯黃。
trad.bpmf: 田裡的稻子󠇡一󠇡片一󠇡片枯黃。

example.en: Field after field of rice turned brown and withered.

simp.text: 自己那十个儿子还在天空里嘻嘻哈哈。

trad.text: 自己那十個兒子還在天空裡嘻嘻哈哈。
trad.bpmf: 自己那十個󠇡兒子󠇡還在天空裡嘻嘻哈哈。

example.en: His own ten sons were still up in the sky giggling and laughing.

simp.text: 那些平常躲得好好的怪兽，也趁机跑出来捣乱。

trad.text: 那些平常躲得好好的怪獸，也趁機跑出來搗亂。
trad.bpmf: 那些平常躲得󠇡好好的怪獸，也趁機跑出來搗亂。

example.en: The monsters that normally stayed well hidden also seized their chance to come out and make mischief.

vocab.en: a divine marksman: the title given to Hou Yi, the greatest archer under heaven

simp.text: 帝俊想到了天底下射箭最厉害的神射手后羿。

trad.text: 帝俊想到了天底下射箭最厲害的神射手后羿。
trad.bpmf: 帝俊想到了天底下射箭最厲害的神射手后羿。

example.en: Dijun thought of Hou Yi, the finest archer under heaven.

vocab.en: Fusang: the giant magical tree by the eastern sea where the ten suns lived

example.en: That tree was called Fusang.

vocab.en: the three-legged golden crow: in Chinese myth, the true form of the sun

simp.text: 变成一只只三脚金乌，摔在地上。

trad.text: 變成一隻隻三腳金烏，摔在地上。
trad.bpmf: 變成一󠇢隻隻三腳金烏，摔在地上。

example.en: They turned into three-legged golden crows and struck the ground.

vocab.en: the mortal world: the human world below, as opposed to heaven

example.en: You and Chang'e will stay in the mortal world.
Let them learn to be afraid.

simp.text: 太阳兄弟觉得好无聊喔。

trad.text: 太陽兄弟覺得好無聊喔。
trad.bpmf: 太陽兄弟覺得󠇡好無聊喔。

example.en: The sun brothers felt so bored.
The eldest was the first to complain.
It would be so lively and fun!
His heart ached terribly.

simp.text: 把他当成救命的大英雄。

trad.text: 把他當成救命的大英雄。
trad.bpmf: 把他當成救命的大英雄。

example.en: They hailed him as the great hero who had saved their lives.

simp.text: 看著这些无辜的人白白受苦。

trad.text: 看著這些無辜的人白白受苦。
trad.bpmf: 看著這些無辜的人白白受苦。

example.en: Watching these innocent people suffer for nothing.

simp.text: 现在看起来，却觉得好陌生。

trad.text: 現在看起來，卻覺得好陌生。
trad.bpmf: 現在看起來，卻覺得󠇡好陌生。

example.en: Now it looked so unfamiliar to her.

vocab.en: to be unwilling to, to not have the heart to

simp.text: 却又舍不得伤害自己的孩子。

trad.text: 卻又捨不得傷害自己的孩子。
trad.bpmf: 卻又捨不得󠇡傷害自己的孩子󠇡。

example.en: Yet he could not bear to harm his own children.

vocab.en: cannot hold back, cannot help oneself

simp.text: 他越看越生气，再也忍不住了。

trad.text: 他越看越生氣，再也忍不住了。
trad.bpmf: 他越看越生氣，再也忍不󠇡住了。

example.en: The more he watched, the angrier he grew, and he could hold back no longer.

vocab.en: to breathe a sigh of relief

simp.text: 后羿擦了擦汗，也总算松了一口气。

trad.text: 后羿擦了擦汗，也總算鬆了一口氣。
trad.bpmf: 后羿擦了擦汗，也總算鬆了一󠇢口氣。

example.en: Hou Yi wiped away his sweat and finally breathed a sigh of relief.
